dedupe_keys.name: eries tltb thunderstorm loading on tall buildings wind tunnel dataset

description: TLTB is a wind tunnel dataset on the loads that thunderstorm downbursts, not ordinary large-scale winds, place on tall buildings. It was produced in the Giovanni Solari wind tunnel of the University of Genoa with NOVA Fluid Mechanics of London, within the European ERIES research infrastructure project, and recorded on Zenodo on 18 May 2026. Both the usual logarithmic wind profile and the nose-shaped profile of thunderstorm outflows were simulated, the latter with passive and active grids, and wind loads and surface pressures were measured at several angles of attack on the CAARC standard tall building, tested in isolation with a high-frequency force balance and pressure taps, and on a real design referred to as Project X. Coverage: two building models in one tunnel. Access: the files are embargoed until 19 November 2026, after which they open under the record's licence. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: laboratory-simulated thunderstorm profiles, and data are not yet available. Simulation uses are validating wind-load models for tall buildings under thunderstorm winds and updating design loads. Related records: the NEES wind-excited benchmark building loads and the AIJ urban wind benchmarks.
